g.text: Day-ahead forecasts and their lagged inputs through four load-shift events

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top panel: black line is the meter reading; blue band and line are the q05 to q95 range and median of the weekly bundle's forecast made 24 to 48 hours earlier. Bottom panel: the same band against the three lagged- power readings that forecast used, drawn at the valid time. Dark grey: hand-labelled event. Light grey: the 24-hour padding that experiment 390's mask adds on each side. A coloured line outside the blue band marks a lagged reading the forecast would not have expected.'
text.tspan: Top panel: black line is the meter reading; blue band and line are the q05 to q95 range and median of the
weekly bundle's forecast made 24 to 48 hours earlier. Bottom panel: the same band against the three lagged-
power readings that forecast used, drawn at the valid time. Dark grey: hand-labelled event. Light grey: the
24-hour padding that experiment 390's mask adds on each side. A coloured line outside the blue band marks a
lagged reading the forecast would not have expected.
